plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: a large left-aligned headline and subline on the left two-thirds, with the Shop Now button and its NEW tag grouped on the right, sharing one vertical centre line, like the original leaderboard but scaled up to fill the height.

Centred stack on one axis: the NEW tag sits as an eyebrow above a big centred headline and subline, and the Shop Now button sits centred underneath, so the eye reads straight down the middle of the wide canvas.

Editorial left-aligned column set in from the left (about where the original's copy starts): NEW eyebrow, then headline and subline, then Shop Now, all sharing one left edge, which keeps the bottom-left clear for a profile photo.
